LanguageData.LP_DivineVessel.label: god-possessed
LanguageData.LP_DivineVessel.description: A god descends through this body. The possessed is immune to stuns, mental breaks and all mental states; when it falls the god leaves the body (different for each god), leaving a miracle fragment behind.
LanguageData.LP_FormerVessel.label: former avatar vessel
LanguageData.LP_FormerVessel.description: A god once descended through this body and left a mark.
LanguageData.LP_Surrendered.label: submitted to judgment
LanguageData.LP_Surrendered.description: Tyr's avatar vessel has submitted to judgment: laid down its weapons, and its wounds no longer bleed.
LanguageData.LP_DawnChild.label: child of the dawn
LanguageData.LP_DawnChild.description: Lathander's morning light flows between the wounds.
LanguageData.LP_BaneFear.label: dread of the tyrant
LanguageData.LP_BaneFear.description: Bane's avatar vessel is nearby; my hands are shaking.
LanguageData.LP_BaneDread.label: cowed
LanguageData.LP_BaneDread.description: Terrified by a servant of the tyrant: move speed ×0.7, doesn't dare fire.
LanguageData.LP_TalosGale.label: Talos's gale
LanguageData.LP_TalosGale.description: Gales rage around the lord of storms, making it hard to aim.
